_note: Captured 2026-07-29 from REAL signed-in DOM, through the app's own WKWebViews — the only
signed-in surface on this device. Simulator Safari is signed out of all four platforms, and the
two cookie jars are not shared, so a value here is evidence about the APP surface.
Provenance distinguishes two strengths of claim, and the distinction is load-bearing. 'resolved'
means an element matched. 'DRIVEN' means the pipeline acted on it and the outcome was asserted —
the only claim that rules out the P1 failure, where every click resolves and lands and the harvest
returns nothing. DRIVEN so far: ChatGPT's composer, and send on all three chat platforms.
isTrusted, settled by driving send on ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini: every dispatched event reported
isTrusted === false on all three, and all three sent the message regardless. No send control gates
on trust, so the app can drive them with evaluateJavaScript. HID taps remain the fallback for a
control that does gate, rather than the default path.
The 12 absent keys are absent on purpose, in four groups:
* needs a response WITH CITATIONS, which a one-word reply does not produce (4): sources on
chatgpt/claude/gemini, and claude.artifact_panel.
* needs a DEEP RESEARCH run in flight (1): chatgpt.activity_panel.
* needs a menu or a notebook open (5): chatgpt.deep_research_toggle and claude.research_toggle
live in the composer's overflow menu; gemini.start_research appears only after submitting in
research mode; notebooklm.add_source and generate_audio are inside a notebook, not on the list.
* a CONTRACT MISMATCH rather than a missing value (1): gemini.deep_research_toggle. Deep Research
there is a mode picked from a menu, while phases.py taps once and judges aria-pressed — see the
note in bin/capture_selectors.py for why capturing the picker would run P0-P3 with deep
research OFF while reporting success.
* notebooklm.audio_ready_marker follows from generate_audio.
surface is ios-app-webview, not ios-mobile-safari: the app pins an iPhone Safari 17 user agent
while Simulator Safari reports 26.5, so the two surfaces are not proven to render the same DOM.

composer.provenance: DRIVEN@ios-app-webview: insertText filled it (execCommand path) and the text was read back

send.provenance: DRIVEN@ios-app-webview: a JS click sent the message — composer cleared, user turn 0->1, assistant replied. Exists ONLY while the composer is non-empty.

response_container.provenance: resolved@ios-app-webview: [data-turn=assistant] on the turn <section>. MEASURED CORRECTION — [data-message-author-role=assistant] was verified on a web-search answer and returns ZERO during a deep-research run, where the only author-role on the page is 'user'. A selector that resolves on one response type and not on the type P2 needs is the P1 shape. data-turn carries 'user' or 'assistant' on both turns and is not index-bound, unlike conversation-turn-N.

deep_research_toggle.provenance: DRIVEN@ios-app-webview: opened the plus menu by HID tap, clicked this item by TEXT among menu roles (the same path resolve() takes, aria-checked=false before), and the ported predicate flipped OFF->ON via pillVisible. NOTE pressed stayed FALSE throughout — an aria-pressed reader sees no change across an activation that plainly happened. TWO steps: open [data-testid=composer-plus-btn] first. NO css on purpose — resolve() tries css before text and a broad [role=menuitem] would match 'Camera', the first of 19 items. ⚠ OPENER PLUMBING EXISTS BUT IS NOT ENABLED HERE. Declaring opener=[data-testid="composer-plus-btn"] worked as designed — the menu opened and the item became resolvable — and REGRESSED the run: the menu STAYS OPEN and covers the send button, so P2 send failed and the pipeline threw. An opener needs a matching dismissal, and that is a phase-lifecycle change, not another manifest field. Left declared-but-absent so the tree is strictly better than before (capability present, inert) rather than worse.

sources.provenance: resolved@ios-app-webview: SCOPED to the response turn — unscoped a[href^=http] matches ChatGPT's nav chrome and would harvest the sidebar as sources. Re-scoped from [data-message-author-role=assistant] for the same reason as response_container: that attribute is absent during a deep-research run. Anchor form measured on a web-search answer ('github.com' -> github.com/swiftlang/swift/releases); the testid form is listed first and is UNVERIFIED, because the known P1 failure is that DR sources render as non-anchor nodes.

activity_panel.provenance: DRIVEN@ios-app-webview: clicked it, aria-expanded went false->true and the turn text grew from 'Worked for 23s' to 'Worked for 23s Searched 7 websites' — the activity content revealed. UNIQUE (1 match): the :not([aria-label]) excludes the three sibling action buttons (Pro feedback / Switch model / More actions), which all carry aria-label. NOT positional — index 0 happens to be right today, and an nth-child would break the moment a button is added. text_contains covers the label family; measured on a REASONING reply ('Worked for Ns'), and a deep-research run may say 'Researched for…' instead, so re-verify the label there.
